@@name@@Indestructible@@icon@@false@@icon2@@Indestructible.png@@icon3@@Indestructible 2.png@@icon4@@{{{icon4}}}@@description@@'''Passive:''' '''Mordekaiser''' stores 45% of the post-mitigation damage he deals and 7.5% of the pre-mitigation damage he takes,「 reduced by 75% for non-champion sources, 」「 reduced to 11.25% of damage dealt and 1.875% of damage taken for non-champion sources, 」as ''Potential Shield'' on his secondary resource bar, up to [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 30% of his '''maximum''' health. The ''Potential Shield'' decays by 8 – 25 (based on level) every second after not dealing or taking damage for 1 second. While ''Indestructible'' is not on cooldown, the ''Potential Shield'' will not decay below a minimum of 5% of his '''maximum''' health, and it will be set to that amount when it comes off cooldown if it was previously below it.@@description2@@'''Active:''' '''Mordekaiser''' consumes his ''Potential Shield'' to grant himself a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for the same amount for 4 seconds. The shield decays exponentially over the duration. ''Indestructible'' can be recast after 0.5 seconds while the shield is active.@@description3@@'''Recast:''' '''Mordekaiser''' consumes the remaining shield, [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] for a portion of the amount.@@description4@@{{{description4}}}@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@
